title: Brand of a product or company

tasks.title: Brand strategy
tasks.text: write the brand strategy for this request (docs/brand/strategy.md): what the brand stands for, who it speaks to and what it may claim.

tasks.title: Name
tasks.text: the brand strategy is done (docs/brand/strategy.md). Find or check the name for this request, where it is free and who else uses it, and write docs/brand/name.md.

tasks.title: Visual identity
tasks.text: the brand strategy is done (docs/brand/strategy.md). Define the visual identity, build its first piece and write docs/brand/identity.md.

tasks.title: Voice
tasks.text: the brand strategy is done (docs/brand/strategy.md). Write how the brand speaks: docs/brand/voice.md. This skill reads docs/brand/profile.md, which no task of this flow writes: for a product or company brand the person writes it by hand, with at least three samples of the brand's own writing marked as theirs (the skill that writes a profile is for a person's brand, not for this).

tasks.title: Brand guide
tasks.text: the strategy, the name, the identity and the voice are done (docs/brand/). Compile them into one guide: docs/brand/guidelines.md.
